description: Engineering strategy document reporting technical strategy or roadmap choices to management: the Rumelt kernel (diagnosis / guiding policy / coherent actions), a SCQA opening, and a policy-first reading order.

rules.instruction: A policy must state what it gives up ("choosing A means not doing B"); a policy without a tradeoff is fluff.
rules.rationale: design §5.4; Rumelt, Good Strategy Bad Strategy, Ch. 5 (§2.2)

rules.instruction: Policies are stated as ratios / thresholds / mechanisms ("new services default to Rust unless X", "20% platform time each quarter"), not direction adjectives.

structure.audienceVariantNote: Approval audience: policy first. Org rollout: policy + operations first. Diagnosis and explore go last but must not be deleted. / 审批场景 policy 前置；组织落地场景 policy+operations 前置；diagnosis/explore 殿后但不可删。
